title: Commerce Payment Event v1
description: Immutable payment event from provider webhook, consumed by entitlement and analytics systems. Idempotent by event_id.

event_id.description: Internal event idempotency key. UUID v4 preferred.

event_type.description: Stable commerce event type including schema version suffix.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this event envelope.

occurred_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the provider recorded the event.

provider_event_id.description: Provider-side event id (e.g., Stripe event id). Used for deduplication and reconciliation.

checkout_session_id.description: Internal checkout session id that generated this payment.

project_access_token_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the opaque project access token. Never the raw token.

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied idempotency key from checkout creation, echoed for traceability.

failure_reason.description: Provider failure code or message when status is failed.

refund_amount.description: Refunded amount in smallest currency unit, when applicable.
